shared_elements: incised/carved symbolic signs on a flat vertical surface
justification: Both are tall upright monolithic surfaces bearing incised signs organised in rough horizontal bands, and each includes a prominent circle or disc, but that is close to the limit of the correspondence. A is a three-dimensional weathered sculpture with a head and sparse, deeply carved curvilinear emblems, whereas B is a flat line drawing of a rounded-top slab with a figural scene above dense, ruled rows of small script-like glyphs — utterly different density, technique and compositional logic.
